moneyVat.title: VAT
moneyVat.sub: The VAT already inside your prices: the switch and your rates. Prices include VAT, so nothing here changes a price.
moneyVat.readOnly: You can see this page; changing it needs the VAT permission.

system.title: VAT system
system.sub: Off as shipped. When on, Sales and reports show the VAT inside them at the rates below. No price, delivery charge or COD changes.
system.off: VAT is off. Nothing shows VAT anywhere.
system.onDelivery: VAT on the delivery charge too
system.onDeliveryHint: At the default rate. Your accountant decides.
system.inclusive: Prices include VAT: VAT is read out of what the customer pays, never added on top.

rates.title: VAT rates
rates.sub: Your own rates, empty as shipped. A product's own rate wins over its category's, a category's over the default. Empty = takes the next one; 0 % is a real rate.
rates.defaultHint: For every product with no product or category rate. Empty = no rate.
rates.example: Example: a {price} price holds {vat} VAT at {pct} %.
rates.noProducts: No product has its own rate.
rates.added: Added below. Set its rate and save.
rates.bad: A rate must be a number from 0 to 50, with at most 2 decimals.

err.INVALID_INPUT: Something is not filled in right. Check the rates.
err.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else saved this a moment ago. Open the page again and check.
err.forbidden: You do not have the permission for this.

report.title: VAT report
report.sub: The VAT already inside what customers paid on delivered orders, by the delivered day. Prices include VAT, so nothing here changes a price.
report.off: The report shows here once the VAT system is on (the switch above).
report.noRateLine: Goods worth {amount} have no VAT rate (SKUs: {skus}). Give them a rate above: their VAT is not counted, never taken as 0%.

byRate.title: By rate
byRate.empty: No delivered orders in this period.

byDay.title: Day by day
byDay.cut: Only the newest {n} days are listed; the CSV has every day.
